questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which of the following represents an analogue signal?
questions.explanation: Medium wave radio uses analogue signal transmission. So it represents an analogue signal.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which binary group indicates 1 byte memory?
questions.explanation: One byte has eight bits. So 00000000 shows one byte.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which is the correct order among the steps of digital signal transmission?
options: Source, input transducer, decoder, modulator, channel, demodulator, encoder, output transducer
Source, input transducer, encoder, demodulator, channel, modulator, decoder, output transducer
Source, encoder, input transducer, modulator, channel, decoder, demodulator, input transducer
Source, input transducer, encoder, modulator, channel, demodulator, decoder, output transducer
questions.explanation: Digital transmission starts from source and input transducer. Then it passes through encoder, modulator, channel, demodulator, decoder and output transducer.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which of the following is an audio file format?
questions.explanation: MP3 is an audio file format. MP4, SVI and 3GP are video formats.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Posting information about new scientific discoveries from time to time on social networks indicates what?
questions.explanation: Useful scientific posts show good online activity. This helps digital reputation management.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is a signal?
options: A physical quantity that changes with time
questions.explanation: Signal means a physical quantity that changes with time. It carries information.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which two digits represent digital signals?
questions.explanation: Digital signals use only 0 and 1. These are called binary digits.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is a bit?
options: The smallest form of data in a computer
questions.explanation: A bit is the smallest data unit in a computer. It means binary digit.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is a byte?
questions.explanation: A byte is a group of eight bits. It is used as one data unit.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which device converts sound into electrical signal in digital communication?
questions.explanation: A microphone changes sound into electrical signal. So it works as an input transducer.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which device converts electrical signals into sound at the output side?
questions.explanation: A loudspeaker changes electrical signal into sound. So it works at the output side.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What does ADC do?
options: Changes analogue signal into digital signal
questions.explanation: ADC means analogue-to-digital converter. It changes analogue signal into digital signal.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What does DAC do?
options: Changes digital signal into analogue signal
questions.explanation: DAC means digital-to-analogue converter. It changes digital signal back into analogue signal.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: How is an analogue signal represented in the chapter?
questions.explanation: Analogue signal is shown as a sine wave. It changes smoothly.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: How is a digital signal represented in the chapter?
questions.explanation: Digital signal is shown as a square wave. It changes between fixed values.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is signal transmission?
options: Transformation of a signal through a medium or channel
A reaction between acid and base
questions.explanation: Signal transmission means sending a signal through a medium or channel. It carries information from sender to receiver.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which type of communication is more affected by external influences?
questions.explanation: Analogue signals are more affected by outside noise. Digital signals are less affected.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which transmission needs a larger bandwidth according to the comparison table?
questions.explanation: Digital communication needs larger bandwidth. Analogue communication needs smaller bandwidth.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is baseband transmission?
options: Transmission of digital signals without converting them into analogue signals
questions.explanation: Baseband sends digital signals directly. It does not first change them into analogue signal.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: For what distance is baseband transmission used?
questions.explanation: Baseband transmission is used for short distance. It sends digital signals directly through a channel.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is broadband transmission?
options: Transmission of digital signals after converting them into analogue signals
questions.explanation: Broadband changes digital signal into analogue form before sending. This is done by modulation.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why are digital signals useful in communication?
options: They always lose more energy than analogue signals
They are clearer and less affected by noise
questions.explanation: Digital signals are clearer and less affected by noise. So they are useful in communication.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which step compresses data to a minimum number of bits?
questions.explanation: An encoder compresses data into fewer bits. This helps save bandwidth.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which step carries the signal from transmitter to receiver?
questions.explanation: A channel is the path for a signal. It carries the signal from transmitter to receiver.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is the first step on the receiver side?
questions.explanation: At the receiver side, demodulator works first. It gets the signal back from the transmitted form.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is digital telecommunication able to do through a single channel or bandwidth?
questions.explanation: Digital telecommunication can carry many calls in one channel. This uses bandwidth efficiently.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which is an example of digital media?
questions.explanation: Digital media uses electronic devices for communication. Examples include mobile, computer and internet tools.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which digital technology allows payment by scanning a QR code?
questions.explanation: QR code payment is a digital payment method. It uses electronic payment instead of cash.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is a netizen?
options: A person who never uses the internet
A citizen of the internet who actively uses and engages in it
questions.explanation: Netizen means a citizen of the internet. It means a person who uses the online world.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is digital citizenship?
options: Only a type of video file
Citizenship of a netizen in the virtual world of the internet
questions.explanation: Digital citizenship means being a responsible citizen online. It is about safe and good internet use.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which behavior shows good internet etiquette?
options: Using polite and civilized language online
questions.explanation: A good netizen uses respectful language online. This shows good digital behaviour.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why should the source be cited when using material from the internet?
options: Because online material is never permanent
Because intellectual property belongs to someone else
Because it changes digital signal to analogue
questions.explanation: Using intellectual property without permission is wrong. It is not good digital citizenship.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is online reputation connected with?
options: Posts, comments, shares and publicly available profile details
questions.explanation: Online actions and profile details show a person's image. So they affect digital reputation.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What risk can poor privacy settings cause?
questions.explanation: Poor privacy settings can cause password theft. They can also harm digital reputation.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is digital well-being?
options: Only using a phone all day
A healthy balance of online and offline activities for mental, physical, social and emotional health
questions.explanation: Digital well-being means a healthy balance between online and offline life. It helps protect health and mind.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which habit helps digital well-being?
options: Setting time limits for social media use
Keeping notifications on at all times
questions.explanation: Limiting social media time is a healthy online habit. It supports digital well-being.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which problem can arise from long online use without balance?
questions.explanation: Too much digital use can harm health. It may cause obesity, insomnia, eye problems and stress.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which file extension is listed as a video format?
questions.explanation: MP4 is a video file format. MP3, WAV and WMA are audio formats.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which software is given as an example for audio editing?
questions.explanation: Audacity is used for editing audio files. So it is useful for audio content creation.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is video editing?
options: Cutting, joining or arranging recorded video clips
questions.explanation: Video editing means cutting and joining video clips. It helps make a final video.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why can misuse of digital technology cause mental stress?
options: Cybercrime or damaged reputation can affect personal and social life
Digital technology always prevents all problems
It stops all social contact automatically
questions.explanation: Cybercrime and bad online reputation can cause stress. So digital safety is important.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: A student records audio with a smartphone microphone. What type of content is being created?
questions.explanation: Audio content can be made by recording sound. A microphone is used for recording.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: A video has an unnecessary part in the middle. Which action from the chapter is most suitable?
questions.explanation: Video cutting removes unnecessary parts. It keeps only the useful part of the video.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which comparison is correct?
options: Digital signal is always a sine wave, analogue is always a square wave
Analogue signal changes continuously, digital signal changes between fixed values
questions.explanation: Analogue signal is continuous. Digital signal has fixed values like 0 and 1.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is encoding useful in digital transmission?
options: It helps compress data and maintain security
questions.explanation: Encoding and compression help protect data and save bandwidth. So they are useful in digital transmission.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which route best represents sound transmission in a digital system?
options: Sound source -> microphone -> encoder/modulator -> channel -> demodulator/decoder -> loudspeaker
Source -> no channel -> no receiver -> no output
questions.explanation: This order follows the main parts of digital communication. The signal goes from source to output step by step.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is digital reputation management important for an organization?
options: Official websites and social media pages affect credibility
questions.explanation: Official online information and followers affect institutional reputation. They show trust and public image.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which statement about online posts is supported by the chapter?
questions.explanation: Anything posted online can stay for a long time. So online posts should be made carefully.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which group contains only digital technologies shown for daily life?
questions.explanation: E-learning, e-commerce and digital payment are digital technologies. They are used in daily life.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is broadband suitable for long-distance transmission?
options: It uses modulation and separate channels or media for sending and receiving
It works only without any channel
It is only a memory unit
questions.explanation: Broadband uses modulation to send signals. It is useful for long-distance transmission.
